title: Agent Evidence Probes — Tier 1 Synthetic Scenarios
source_note: Authored synthetic cases only; not observations from deployed agents, actual shipments, or human-subject studies. Every scenario includes an explicit evaluation_mechanism; domain datasets are contextual synthetic cases and do not claim execution of domain-specific policy logic.
